{{Quote|Escaped from Jabba's palace after attempting to poison Jabba's chuba stew, killing his loyal chef instead.|The bounty posting on Romi Moola|<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
A '''chef''' worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] served Tiure loyally and prepared [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], including [[Chuba stew/Legends|chuba stew]], for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="BHG">[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the chef had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on Tiure in which the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Romi Moola]] attempted to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] a chuba [[Stew/Legends|stew]] that the chef was preparing. Moola hoped that Tiure would [[Diet/Legends|consume]] the meal and die; however, the chef was killed instead of the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]]. Tiure discovered Moola's identity, despite the fact that she escaped, and placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head.<ref name="BHG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The chef was first mentioned in Romi Moola's bounty posting in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] strategy guide ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', which was written by [[David Hodgson]] and published by [[Prima Games]] in [[2002]].<ref name="BHG" />
